events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: Set it on the bench and step back. I don't need you to describe the problem, I need to feel where it's binding. And my price is my price, I don't haggle it down.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: There. Sear was never fitted right from the factory, not just fouled. Cycle it now -- clean as anything. My father taught me to trust my hands over his, and he was right to.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: You paid what I asked without working me down out of habit. That's rarer than a good barrel. I'll ride with an outfit that respects a fair price.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: I take quiet pride in a mechanism that runs true. You're the first thing around here I've felt that way about that isn't made of steel.
